text:
Dawson Mercer had four assists in ten games for New Jersey when the Devils sent him to Winnipeg on October 23 in the Connor Hellebuyck trade, which closed the Jets' saga with a goalie who asked out and was suspended for not reporting to camp. Mercer has been the best thing to come out of it for Winnipeg so far: five goals and eight points in ten games as a Jet.

The best night was the obvious one. He scored twice against the Devils on November 10, with Hellebuyck not in the New Jersey net, then scored twice more against Dallas. Winnipeg has won five straight.

Is it real? Mostly. His shooting (12.2%) is about where our numbers expect, and he's getting more ice in Winnipeg, around 16 minutes. The finishing will level out, but the role looks stable. A 25-year-old who has scored 20 goals three times is not a lucky accident; the Jets may just be getting the full version of him.
headline: Mercer is making the Jets look smart
